verdict.rationale: Linear acts as a shared handoff hub. Issues can be delegated to external agents such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor and Devin, as well as to Linear Agent running Claude Code or Codex. Agents behave like workspace users that comment and collaborate on issues, projects and documents, and delegation keeps human ownership, so the issue thread serves as the persistent shared context; an MCP server also exposes that context to Claude and Cursor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that context and history are fully carried across agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoffs, independent or hands-on corroboration that handoffs are lossless.
